notes.title: Winter Update 2.0.4 New Weapons, Gear and Biome
notes.content:
This [b]major update[/b] delivers a host of exciting new features, meaningful improvements, and carefully crafted refinements to elevate your gameplay experience. As the holiday season approaches, we want to wish everyone a joyful and festive Christmas, and we can’t wait to see you all in the game!

[list]
[*] New Gear and Weapons: Discover five new gun types, each with added rarity tiers, increasing the total collectible guns to over 70.
[*] New Biome: Explore the Snow Biome, complete with temperature mechanics for an added survival challenge.
[*] Off-Hand Slot: Equip off-hand items like torches, allowing for versatile gameplay while using your main hand for other tasks.
[*] Vehicle Enhancements: Vehicles now feature health bars, speedometers, and fuel indicators. Beware of mob attacks on vehicles, which can cause damage and require repairs using a toolbox.
[*] Crop Plot Improvements: Added functionality to pick up crop plots for easier relocation.
[*] Motion Camera Shake Fix: Resolved camera shake issues when hitting objects, reducing motion sickness.
[*] Mouse Sensitivity Settings: Customize your mouse sensitivity for precise control.
[*] Container Interaction: Pressing E while a container is open will now also close it for seamless inventory management.
[*] Auto-Save Optimization: Auto-saving has been significantly improved to eliminate lag spikes.
[*] Gameplay Balancing: All mobs and weapons have been rebalanced for a more polished and enjoyable gameplay experience.
[/list]

Get ready to explore, survive, and thrive with these updates!

notes.title: News : More information on Gear Sets
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share some more news about the upcoming patch and gear sets! The highlight of this update is the introduction of brand-new gear sets, each offering unique bonuses when equipped. These sets not only enhance gameplay but also bring a fresh look to the game as we prepare for our full release.

[b]Revamped Gear and Enhanced Player Stats[/b]

As part of our ongoing efforts to polish the game, we’re reworking much of the existing clothing with higher-quality models and improved designs. But the improvements don’t stop at aesthetics—these new gear sets will also include stat boosts to enhance your character’s base attributes. For example, we've been hard at work redesigning the police gear set. The new police outfit will grant increased armor, enhanced base stats such as Strength and Dexterity, and an expanded Health pool, enabling you to withstand tougher encounters with enemies and zombies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43953645/e69e90a66347dcc86b7f35fe11127d34a96b6f67.png[/img]

Additionally, gear pieces will come in various rarity levels, each offering additional bonuses. This means that players can mix and match rare gear for even greater benefits, tailoring their loadouts to their specific playstyle and objectives.

[b]Why Gear Sets Matter[/b]

Beyond improving aesthetics, these gear sets are designed to provide meaningful stat boosts that will be essential as the game evolves. As we introduce new biomes, players will face stronger enemies and more challenging bosses. Having the right gear for the job will be critical.

Players will have the flexibility to choose gear sets that align with their goals. For instance:

[list]
[*] Combat Runs: Equip sets that boost firepower, armor, or health to handle intense battles.
[*] Resource Gathering: Opt for gear that increases harvesting efficiency or boosts luck, enhancing your chances of finding rare items.
[*] Exploration: Use gear that offers stamina regeneration or agility to navigate difficult terrains.
[/list]
This system encourages strategic planning, allowing players to adapt their approach for every scenario. Whether you’re battling hordes of enemies or scouring the land for resources, the right gear will give you a crucial edge.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

We’re just a couple of weeks away from rolling out this exciting update, and we can’t wait for you to experience the new gear sets firsthand. These additions are designed to enhance your journey, offering more customization and deeper gameplay. Stay tuned as we continue to refine and expand the world to prepare for the full release.

Thank you for your continued support—we’re eager to hear your feedback and see how you use these new tools to conquer the challenges ahead!

notes.title: Upcoming November Update
notes.content:
Today I would like to share some information on our next major update coming to Junk Survivor in November. This will be a big update as we have been working on it for the past two months. With this update we are moving much closer to full release with a new snowy Biome being added, more types of NPC mobs and new vehicles.

We have also started adding new clothing/armor gear players can craft and gather that will give specific perks when equipped. For instance the Miner Gear Set will increase base stats as well as increase the amount of loot a player gets from mining activities. Players will be able to get these gear sets in many different ways and display them in their bases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43953645/835770f699b9cd4377ea6a7642e3b0acd7db8c2c.png[/img]

Another nice thing we are adding to this major update coming in November will be new Points Of Interest, for instance a military base allowing  Players to build their own Tanks, Hummers or Helicopters at certain locations. Yes you will be able to drive a tank or fly a helicopter and yes you will be able to drive over zombies with the tank!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43953645/71384f0ed8ab44d1b1ab8bb339ae81c67bd9cd46.png[/img]

As always we will be fixing bugs and improving game play as well as adding other content. Be sure to add Junk Survivor to your wishlist if you have not yet purchased the game and thank you for all your support!

notes.title: Update 1.9.0 - More farming animals added!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added bounce effect and particle effects to most resources harvested with tools.
[*] Fixed Pig Hut to make Leather and Rot..
[*] Added Cow mob.
[*] Reworked the Fuel system so it does not over generate ash and cause lag.
[*] Added Large Animal Traps which allows players to capture cows and sheep to craft Cow Pens and Sheep Pens. Sheep Pen will generate Wool/Raw Meat and Cow Pen will generate Raw Prime Meat and Rot.
[*] Fixed medical tray collusion which was preventing the pickup of bandages and pills in the hospital building. Now players can pickup pain pills and Bandages there.
[*] Added Seed merchant where players can buy and sell seeds.
[*] Improved saving lag but we still have some work to do with it.
[*] Fixed bug where the compass display doubles on death.

[*] Changed how the Raider mobs take damage, now they will only have a 20% chance of being staggered when a player hits them preventing players from constantly staggering a enemy and just killing him.

[*] Updated display when chatting with a NPC Trader.
[*] Copper Ore, Copper Ingot and Copper Wire added.

notes.title: Major Update 1.8.0
notes.content:
This is a major update with many fixes and new items. Because its such a major update it will require a restart as old save files wont have the new stuff in it and will break the game. A Lot of things was changed and added from player feedback.

[list]
[*] Increase Simple Backpack storage to 14 extra slots.
[*] Add 4 more Backpack types to be crafted at a sewing table.
[*] Increase Chicken and Pig Hit box.
[*] Fixed zombie Bear Death animation to not loop.
[*] Fixed Death Loot bag bug where when you loot it and there is more items than empty slots you have available it would still loot all and you would loose some items. Now if there is no more empty slots the remaining items will stay inside the loot bag.
[*] When Death Loot Bag is empty or when the timer runs out it will destroy the loot bag as well as the Death marker. So if a player does not see his Death Marker anymore it means the loot bag is destroyed.
[*] Added header information to Furnace to explain how to craft ingots.
[*] Fixed Backpacks not showing up on back on Buffed Guy when equipped.
[*] Added Composter Book to traders.
[*] Fixed the Meat Pile, when destroyed now it will stop mobs spawning from it and will drop bones which is used to craft a placeable meat pile. Could be used to make a Zombie farm.
[*] Increase water bottle refill of thirst from 15% to 25%
[*] Fixed Trees respawning when the trunk is destroyed when loading game in.
[*] Fixed foundations being placed and then destroyed if terrain has a slight slope. Now if a foundation cant be placed it will just show red.
[*] Reduced Hunger and Thirst consumption so its more balanced.
[*] New Sheep mob added and new wool and yarn items added which will be used to craft items in a Sewing Table.
[*] Increased Bow and arrow damage.
[*] Changed it so that a player only has a 30% chance to get staggered when being attacked, this way when cornered a player still has a chance to kill the mob.
[*] Changed Skill icons to be green when a player can learn a new skill and yellow on learned skills.
[*] Added new Range Damage Increase Skill which increases the damage done by bows and crossbows.
[*] Split stat points and skill points so now when a player levels they don't need to choose between the two to spend their points on as each one will have its own points to assign.
[*] Added Metal ore nodes to mine metal ore which can then be smelted in a furnace to make metal scraps.
[*] Added Clay piles that can be mined to get clay and dirt.
[*] Fixed a bug where some items merchants sell they would not buy like some books. Now any item a merchant sells they will also buy.
[*] Added Truck vehicle assembly station to Mr Two Cars area so players can now assemble a truck. Its still experimental and expect bugs. Character is missing sitting animation. Make sure to grab your truck Key from the assembly and don't loose the key!
[/list]

[h1]Next Update Coming To Junk Survivor![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43953645/edeeee85f88da93ade2c97050e4d28cca99ee589.png[/img]

Dear Valiant Survivors,

We are thrilled to share a sneak peek into the exciting developments coming your way! Our post-apocalyptic world is expanding, with a new faction "Red Fist" adding some enriched game lore that will captivate your imagination.

In the grim aftermath of a devastating zombie apocalypse, a faction known as the "Red Fist" emerged as an unexpected force. This group's origin story is steeped in mystery and intrigue, and their formation remains a source of speculation among survivors.

As the world descended into chaos and the zombie outbreak raged on, the Red Fist faction had access to underground bunkers, where they initially took refuge as the world outside collapsed. While underground, they harnessed their AI technology to serve their sinister objectives. Instead of using their advanced knowledge to help humanity, they chose to exploit their skills for personal gain and domination.

The Red Fist used this technologies to terrorize and control the post-apocalyptic wasteland. This included automated killing machines, surveillance networks, and advanced weaponry. They viewed other survivors as resources to be exploited and dominated rather than adding them as potential allies. They raided settlements, kidnapped survivors, and established a network of brutal subjugation.

This is just a glimpse of what's in store for you. The enriched lore will provide context and depth to every adventure you undertake.

Stay tuned for more announcements, teasers, and release dates as we prepare to unveil this exciting new content. The survival of our world, and the journey ahead is within your grasp.

Survive, adapt, and conquer!

notes.title: Major Multiplayer Update : Alpha 1.2.8.2
notes.content:
We are excited to announce our multiplayer release of Junk Survivor Alpha 1.2.8.2. Do note this is still experimental and you will encounter bugs. Ensure that you delete all previous saves and start a fresh game. This release brings a new survivor to choose at the start of the game, a bigger world map, more things to craft, more vehicles and most importantly fishing! 

As you can see on our roadmap, we have completed most of the items we were aiming to finish in this release. Players will now be able to create a co-op multiplayer server where friends can join in on the fun. Players can make the server open to anyone to join. They can also add in a password which they can send to their friends, so only invited guests are given access to enter a player’s server. There are also other options to allow a player to customize their server. 

With this release, zombies will now attack a player's building to get to the player. Be sure to build up some reinforced walls to keep the zombies at bay!

We have added more vehicles to build, so players can all have different rides in a multiplayer session. This will require more fuel, so world crafting stations like an Oil Pump can supply Oil Barrels which can be processed into fuel at a chemistry table. There are only a few stations in the world, so if you have a PvP server you might want to protect one for yourself.

You will be able to fish and drink water at the many ponds around the map. Fish can be cooked on its own to eat or cooked with other items to get better food. You will require a fishing rod and some worms, so be sure to place down a composter to get those worms fast! 

Along with all these new features, we have also spent some time fixing bugs and improving some systems. Most requested was for players to be able to pick up/move crafting stations they have placed down. If there are no items inside a crafting station, you will now be able to pick up the station and place it down again. To make things easier for new players, we added a short tutorial explaining the game systems, so they can get going fast. We hope all of you will enjoy this update and we are looking forward to playing Junk Survivor with you all!


[list]
[*] [b]Multiplayer Support[/b] - Setup multiplayer support.
[*] [b]Increase map size[/b] - Increase map size to accommodate multiplayer.
[*] [b]More Vehicles[/b] - Added additional vehicles to build.
[*] [b]Zombie Base Attack[/b] - Zombies are able to attack your base.
[*] [b]Second Survivor[/b] - Added in second survivor to choose from in Character Creation.
[*] [b]Zombie Wild Animals[/b] - Added Zombie Wild Animals like Bear, Boar, Rat and Vulture.
[*] [b]New Crafting Station[/b] - Added Composter station to craft worms for fishing and fertilizer.
[*] [b]Fishing[/b] - Add fishing in rivers and lakes.
[*] [b]World Crafting Stations[/b] - Add world crafting stations for mass production of certain resources which is already spawned in the world, creates PvP opportunities. (Added Oil Pump, Scrap Metal Extraction.)
[*] [b]Secondary Interaction Key[/b] - Key settings for secondary Interaction.
[*] [b]Increase simple chest slots[/b] - Increase simple chest slots with second row.
[*] [b]Fix Mobs just standing[/b] - Fix Mobs just standing and not attacking.
